reproduction_target: Assembly of mimosoid host organellar genomes (Anadenanthera colubrina, Vachellia collinsii); phylogenetic classification of Lophophytum spp. mitochondrial protein-coding genes as native / foreign / chimeric; mtDNA transcription-level analysis of L. pyramidale; RNA editing site identification and editing-efficiency comparison between native and foreign gene regions; phylogenetic origin assignment of nuclear-encoded mitochondrial RNA-maturation factors. All described Methods are computational analyses of sequencing data generated in prior work or downloaded from public archives; no wet-lab protocol is described in this manuscript.
granularity_note: One step per named tool/analysis invocation extracted from the MATERIALS AND METHODS prose (5 subsections). |S| = 29 computational steps, |W| = 0 (no wet-lab protocol described; DNA/RNA sequencing is attributed to prior publications and public archives). Scoring convention applied uniformly: (a) Version = 1 (subtier exact_pins_partial) when an exact version string is given in prose, 0 when the tool is named without any version (gap 2a) — prose pins can never reach 2 because no environment closure is claimed; (b) Params = 2 only when all substantive non-default options are stated, 1 when key options are stated but the invocation is incomplete, 0 when no parameters are stated at all; (c) manual-curation and visual-inspection steps (Consed editing, Bandage/FigTree/Geneious visualisation, visual examination of alignments) score Code = 0 because no script or recorded action log exists. Bowtie2 is credited Version = 1 in the RNA-seq steps because v.2.2.2 is pinned earlier in the same Methods section even though the later citation omits it.

steps.label: Plastid genome (ptDNA) de novo assembly of Anadenanthera colubrina and Vachellia collinsii — NOVOplasty v.2.6.2, seeds Acacia ligulata NC_026134.2 and Vachellia tortilis subsp. raddiana KY100266.1
Manual curation and visualisation of the two ptDNA assemblies — Consed v.29.0
Mitochondrial genome de novo assembly from mimosoid DNA-seq — SPAdes v.3.15.2, coverage cutoff set to automatic (details in Table S1)
Identification of putative mitochondrial contigs by BLASTn against a custom database of Mimoseae mitochondrial DNA downloaded from NCBI (Table S2A)
Assembly-graph visualisation of putative mitochondrial contigs — Bandage v.0.8.1
Individual extension of mitochondrial contigs — SSAKE v.3.8.5 (settings in Table S1)
Manual editing, joining and circularisation of mitochondrial contigs from consistent paired-end reads — Consed v.29
Organellar read-depth computation — Bowtie2 v.2.2.2 (--end-to-end --very-fast), SAMtools v.1.10, BEDtools v.2.26.0
Read-depth plotting for the organellar genomes — R software v.4.2.2
Nucleotide alignment of angiosperm mitochondrial gene sets (Table S2B) — muscle as implemented in AliView v.1.27
Maximum-likelihood gene trees for Lophophytum mitochondrial genes — RAxML v.8.2.11, GTR+gamma, 1,000 rapid bootstrap pseudoreplicates (no random seed reported)
Phylogenetic tree visualisation and foreign/native call at BS > 70% — FigTree v.1.4.4
Detection of gene-conversion tracts / chimeric genes — Geneconv v.1.81a, significance p < 0.05, alignments incorporating Santalales and mimosoid species (Table S2C)
Visual examination of gene alignments plus subregion phylogenies and BLASTn of 100 bp flanking sequences to classify subregions as foreign (BS > 70% with Fabaceae)

Strand-specific alignment of rRNA-depleted total RNA reads (SRR31014705) to each L. pyramidale mitochondrial chromosome — Bowtie2 (--end-to-end, --sensitive, --no-discordant, --no-mixed, -R 10; --fr / --nofw, each strand separately)
Visualisation of the RNA-seq mapping — Geneious v.2023.1.1
Bowtie2 alignment of all RNA reads to L. pyramidale mtDNA protein-coding CDS extended by 300 bp at each end, and plotting of the resulting read depth — Bowtie2 + R v.4.2.2

Background-transcription estimation from noncoding chromosomes and read-depth significance threshold at p <= 0.05 following Wu et al. 2015 (500 bp genomic windows, 5% tail of the read-depth distribution)
RNA editing site calling and editing-efficiency computation for L. pyramidale (SRR31014705) and Ombrophytum subterraneum (SRR31014706) — bam-readcount plus custom scripts
Prediction of editing sites for comparison — PREPACT3 v.3.12.0, BLASTX editing mode, against a curated set of angiosperm mitochondrial genomes (set not enumerated)
Statistical comparison of editing efficiency between native and foreign gene regions — Shapiro-Wilk normality test then Wilcoxon rank-sum test (statistical software not named)

Cross-angiosperm editing-efficiency comparison of genes homologous to native vs foreign L. mirabile genes, using the 17-angiosperm editing-site dataset of Edera et al. 2018 (no accession or download location given)
Inference of host-specific non-synonymous C-to-U editing sites by four-taxon comparison (L. pyramidale, L. mirabile, Ombrophytum, Acacia ligulata) under the stated two-part criterion
De novo transcriptome assembly of L. pyramidale and O. subterraneum RNA-seq — Trinity v2.15.0 (--SS_lib_type RF, --min_contig_length 100)
Extraction of ORFs > 100 bp from the transcriptome assemblies — TransDecoder v.5.7.0 (https://github.com/TransDecoder/TransDecoder)
Assignment of Arabidopsis mitochondrial RNA-maturation genes to orthogroups across the species of interest using OrthoFinder clustering results (Table S4; Ceriotti et al. unpublished)
Multiple protein-sequence alignment of nuclear RNA-maturation factor homologues — MAFFT (no version, no strategy/options stated)
Trimming of poorly aligned regions / divergent sequences — TrimAl (-resoverlap 0.5, -seqoverlap 50, -gt 0.3; no version)
Maximum-likelihood phylogenies of nuclear RNA-maturation factors — IQ-TREE with the Q.plant substitution model and 1,000 ultrafast bootstrap replicates, robust threshold > 95% (no version, no seed)

gaps.where: whole manuscript - no Data Availability or Code Availability section exists; Methods, Acknowledgements and Author contributions contain no analysis-code link
gaps.missing: No code repository (GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket/Zenodo/Software Heritage) is stated anywhere. The only URL in the manuscript is the upstream homepage of a third-party tool (https://github.com/TransDecoder/TransDecoder), not authors' analysis code.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the assembly, mapping, editing-calling and phylogenetic driver scripts in a citable archive (Zenodo DOI or a tagged GitHub release) and add a Code Availability statement.

gaps.where: C19 (RNA editing site and efficiency calling)
gaps.missing: Verbatim: 'analyzed the alignments with the bam-readcount program [49] and customs scripts'. The custom scripts are neither deposited nor described in enough detail to reconstruct the editing-site calling thresholds (minimum depth, minimum edited fraction, base-quality filter).
gaps.how_to_close: Publish the custom scripts and state the calling thresholds.

gaps.where: C02, C07 (Consed manual curation), C14 (visual examination of alignments)
gaps.missing: Assembly joining, circularisation and chimerism subregion delimitation involve manual, unrecorded human intervention. No edit log or decision record is provided, so these steps cannot be re-executed from inputs.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the Consed ace/edit files or a machine-readable record of the manual joins, and the exact subregion coordinates used for the split phylogenies.

gaps.where: C04 BLASTn, C14 BLASTn, C18 background-transcription analysis, C19 bam-readcount, C21 statistics software, C22 comparison analysis, C26 OrthoFinder, C27 MAFFT, C28 TrimAl, C29 IQ-TREE
gaps.missing: Tool named with no version string. Ten of 29 steps carry no version information at all (Version axis = 0), including the two phylogenetic-inference-critical tools of the nuclear-gene section (MAFFT, IQ-TREE) and the editing-caller (bam-readcount).
gaps.how_to_close: State exact versions for every named tool, and ideally ship a conda/pixi lock or container digest covering them.

gaps.where: whole Methods - all version information is scattered prose pins
gaps.missing: Where versions ARE given (NOVOplasty v.2.6.2, Consed v.29.0, SPAdes v.3.15.2, Bandage v.0.8.1, SSAKE v.3.8.5, Bowtie2 v.2.2.2, SAMtools v.1.10, BEDtools v.2.26.0, R v.4.2.2, AliView v.1.27, RAxML v.8.2.11, FigTree v.1.4.4, Geneconv v.1.81a, Geneious v.2023.1.1, PREPACT3 v.3.12.0, Trinity v2.15.0, TransDecoder v.5.7.0) there is no environment closure: no interpreter/runtime pin beyond R, no package channel/index, no declared platform, no lockfile or image digest. Version axis is therefore capped at 1 (subtier exact_pins_partial) for every pinned step.
gaps.how_to_close: Ship conda-lock / pixi.lock / renv.lock or a container image referenced by digest, declaring the platform.

gaps.where: C11 (RAxML 1,000 rapid bootstrap), C29 (IQ-TREE 1,000 ultrafast bootstrap), C24 (Trinity assembly)
gaps.missing: No random seed is reported for any stochastic step. Bootstrap support values and, for Trinity, contig-level output are therefore reproducible only distributionally, not bit-for-bit.
gaps.how_to_close: Report the -p/-x (RAxML) and -seed (IQ-TREE) values actually used.

gaps.where: C04 (custom Mimoseae mtDNA BLAST database), C20 (PREPACT3 'curated set of angiosperm mitochondrial genomes')
gaps.missing: The custom BLAST database is described only as 'downloaded from NCBI (Table S2A)' with no download date; the PREPACT3 reference set is a web-service-internal curated collection whose composition and version are not stated. Neither is deposited as a fixed artifact.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the exact FASTA of the custom database (or list accessions with a retrieval date) and record the PREPACT3 reference-set identifier.

gaps.missing: Verbatim: 'using OrthoFinder clustering results (Table S4; Ceriotti et al. unpublished)'. A load-bearing intermediate depends on an unpublished third-party analysis, so this sub-pipeline is externalised and cannot be re-run.
gaps.how_to_close: Deposit the OrthoFinder run inputs/outputs, or cite the source once published.

gaps.where: C15, C17, C19 (all L. pyramidale mtDNA-referenced steps)
gaps.missing: The L. pyramidale mitochondrial genome (81 chromosomes) is the alignment target for the transcription and editing analyses, but no GenBank accession for it is stated in this manuscript. Only the mimosoid host organellar genomes are given accessions (PX438801, PV798382, PV826156). The reference against which reads are mapped is therefore not resolvable from this paper alone.
gaps.how_to_close: State the accession (or the prior publication and accession) for the L. pyramidale mtDNA assembly used as reference.

gaps.missing: Geneious Prime is commercial software; the step is pinned (v.2023.1.1) but requires a paid licence. Flagged license-gated. In this paper the step is visualisation only, so it does not gate a numeric result.
gaps.how_to_close: Substitute or additionally describe an open-source visualisation route (e.g. IGV) for the mapping inspection.

gaps.where: C04, C10, C13, C20, C22 - external reference resources
gaps.missing: NCBI-derived reference sets (Tables S2A/S2B/S2C), the PREPACT3 reference collection and the Edera et al. 2018 editing-site dataset are all referenced in prose without a versioned DOI, retrieval date or digest. At Stage 1 no env_capture_class can be assigned (no executable workflow exists to inspect); all steps carry env_capture_class 'n/a'.
gaps.how_to_close: Pin every external resource by versioned accession list + retrieval date, ideally inside a download rule in a deposited workflow.
